user.title: Smoobu
user.description: Enter the API key and secret from Smoobu (Advanced → API Keys). The label is only the key's name and is not needed.

data_description.api_key: Value from the 'Key' column in the list under Advanced → API Keys – not the label.
data_description.api_secret: The secret shown in the window after creating the key. Shown only once.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Smoobu
reauth_confirm.description: The key was rejected. Enter a new API key and secret.

data_description.api_key: Value from the 'Key' column in the list under Advanced → API Keys – not the label.
data_description.api_secret: The secret shown in the window after creating the key. Shown only once.

abort.already_configured: This Smoobu account is already configured.

data.enrich_count: Fetch details for next n bookings

data_description.scan_interval: Fallback polling in addition to the webhook.
data_description.use_webhook: Smoobu pushes booking changes instantly via Nabu Casa.
data_description.default_checkin: Used when the booking has no arrival time.
data_description.default_checkout: Used when the booking has no departure time (official guest check-out time).
data_description.enrich_count: Enrich current + next n bookings per apartment with first/last name, city tax etc.
data_description.checkout_buffer: Time after check-out until the actual release, e.g. until cleaning starts. Release = departure time (from Smoobu, else default check-out) + waiting time, e.g. 11:00 + 30 min = 11:30. Used by "Occupied", "Release" and automations based on them.
data_description.payment_excluded_channels: Bookings from these channels do not count as unpaid (the portal collects payment, Smoobu still reports "unpaid").
data_description.history_years: Years before the current year loaded for analyses and comparisons. Ignored if “Load data since” is set.
data_description.history_since: Alternative to the years: load bookings from this date. Leave empty = “Years of history” applies. At least from 1 January of the previous year (for year-on-year comparisons).
data_description.settings_users: Besides administrators, these Home Assistant users may change the Smoobu settings via the settings card in the dashboard.

provisionen.title: Commissions & direct channels
provisionen.description: Used for net revenue and direct vs. portal. Percentages only apply when Smoobu sends no commission with the booking (Airbnb and Booking.com usually do). Booking.com payment charges are read from the booking.

data_description.commission_other: For portals without their own entry.
data_description.commission_custom: Format: Channel=percent; Channel=percent (e.g. Expedia=18; HomeToGo=15). Channel name as shown in Smoobu.
data_description.direct_channels: Revenue from these channels counts as direct; all others as portal.

kosten.title: Costs & prices
kosten.description: Variable costs for the contribution margin (net − variable costs) and the markups from the Smoobu pricing tool for recommendations. Fixed costs (property tax, insurance, internet …) don't belong here – a booking doesn't change them. Heating and hot water are spread over the months by heating degree days (January ≈ 12× July) and scaled to the guest nights of the billing year.

data.cost_hot_water_year: Hot water costs in billing year

data_description.cost_heating_year: From the utility bill (holiday flat share only).
data_description.cost_ref_year: Year of the bill – the annual costs are spread over its guest nights.
data_description.cost_pv_value: PV power used by the guest would otherwise have been fed in.
data_description.channel_markups: Format: channel=percent; channel=percent (e.g. Airbnb=33; Booking.com=45; HomeToGo=10).
data_description.lastminute_days: A free night this many days before arrival counts as last minute (1–14).
data_description.lastminute_max_discount: Only for gaps between two guests or weakly booked months, never below the floor.

assistent.title: AI assistant
assistent.description: Reply suggestions for guest messages with a knowledge base and learning from your replies. Nothing is sent to guests without confirmation. When AI is allowed, guest messages and booking data are sent to the chosen AI provider. Knowledge base, learning, import, daily briefing and gap report also work without AI.

data.assistant: Automatic reply suggestions for new guest messages

data_description.ai_enabled: Off = AI fully locked: no suggestions, no "build knowledge", no data sent to an AI provider. The AI buttons in the cards are greyed out.
data_description.assistant: On by default. Only works when AI is allowed. On-demand suggestions (✨ in the card) work without this option.
data_description.ai_entity: e.g. Google Gemini, called via ai_task.generate_data.
data_description.assist_status: e.g. heating, door, outdoor temperature – helps with problem reports.

benachrichtigungen.title: Notifications
benachrichtigungen.description: Which pushes go to whom and when. Check-in, cleaning or dog notices from your own automations are independent of this.

buchung.name: New booking
buchung.description: Guest, dates, nights, guests, channel, price and 🐕 – as soon as the booking exists in Smoobu.

data_description.empfaenger: Empty = recipients of the previous assistant setting. Only mobile_app services support buttons.

storno.name: Cancellation / change
storno.description: Cancelled, or dates, guests, arrival time or price changed (before → after).

data_description.empfaenger: Empty = recipients of the previous assistant setting. Only mobile_app services support buttons.

nachricht.name: New guest message
nachricht.description: Message text when no AI suggestion is sent (AI off, suggestion push off or suggestion failed). Disappears once answered or marked done.

data_description.empfaenger: Empty = recipients of the previous assistant setting. Only mobile_app services support buttons.

vorschlag.name: AI reply suggestion
vorschlag.description: Suggestion with Send/Edit/Ignore buttons (only with AI allowed and automatic suggestions). Urgent suggestions also arrive during quiet hours.

data_description.empfaenger: Empty = recipients of the previous assistant setting. Only mobile_app services support buttons.

zahlung.name: Payment reminder
zahlung.description: Open amount of a booking X days before arrival and on the arrival day (excluding channels paid via the portal).

data_description.empfaenger: Empty = recipients of the previous assistant setting. Only mobile_app services support buttons.

briefing.name: Daily briefing
briefing.description: Arrivals, departures, changeovers and unanswered messages of the day.

data_description.empfaenger: Empty = recipients of the previous assistant setting. Only mobile_app services support buttons.

luecken.name: Unbookable gaps
luecken.description: Gaps ≤ 30 days that cannot be booked because of the minimum stay, with a button to adjust.

data_description.empfaenger: Empty = recipients of the previous assistant setting. Only mobile_app services support buttons.

ruhezeit.name: Quiet hours
ruhezeit.description: New bookings, cancellations/changes and non-urgent suggestions are collected during quiet hours and delivered at the end (latest state per booking only). Briefing, gaps and payments arrive at their time.

data_description.nachrichten_sofort: A guest who cannot get in at night should not wait until morning.

wohnungen.title: Property codes
wohnungen.description: Code per property for dashboard and pushes (up to {max} characters, letters/digits, unique across all Smoobu accounts). Empty = automatic. Automatic codes: {auto}.

error.ai_entity_required: Please select an AI or turn off "Allow AI features".
error.invalid_grid_share: Please enter exactly 12 values between 0 and 100.

allow_booking.description: Must be on to cancel a direct booking.

set_rates.name: Set rates

min_stay.name: Minimum stay
min_stay.description: Nights; leave empty to keep it.

update_reservation.name: Update booking
update_reservation.description: Changes arrival/departure time, note or payment status of a booking.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with several Smoobu accounts.

price_paid.name: Paid
price_paid.description: Mark the total price as paid (on) or open (off).

prepayment_paid.name: Prepayment paid
prepayment_paid.description: Mark the prepayment as paid or open.

deposit_paid.name: Deposit paid
deposit_paid.description: Mark the deposit as paid or open.

assistant_suggest.name: Assistant: suggestion
assistant_suggest.description: Creates a message draft for a booking.

message.name: Guest message
message.description: Optional; otherwise the guest's last message.

push.name: Send push

assistant_import.name: Assistant: import history
assistant_import.description: Loads the messages of guest bookings and stores your replies as learning examples.

assistant_build_knowledge.name: Assistant: build knowledge
assistant_build_knowledge.description: Creates knowledge base suggestions from your templates and replies (for approval).
